title: Sommerabend am Berg
identity: Fritz Mareczek’s *Sommerabend am Berg: Impression* is listed by the retailer search result as Zimmermann ZM11840, an eight-page piano-accompanied part for English horn or E-flat alto saxophone. Mareczek’s work is also cataloged in its original 1955 form as an impression for English horn and orchestra; the saxophone-and-piano issue is an alternate chamber arrangement.

evidence.claim: Zimmermann item ZM11840 is identified as alto saxophone in E-flat (or cor anglais) and piano, eight pages, published 1956.
Library catalog identifies a print edition as English horn or E-flat alto saxophone and piano.
Oboe specialist source lists the original orchestral impression for English horn (1955).

review_focus: Inference: compare the alto-sax version with the English-horn source if orchestral materials become available; no saxophone notation was inspected.
collection_flag: Published alternate for E-flat alto saxophone of an English-horn orchestral impression; the cataloged saxophone edition is with piano.
